note: Grow the edit-song library from legit, redistributable sources only. Action edits: phonk, drift phonk, Brazilian phonk, slowed+reverb, and fast-edit beat-drop tracks. Love/romance edits: mid-tempo emotional, sad, and romantic beds (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA or public domain). No boring NCS-style beds for action, no podcasts, no OST dumps. Sources: Internet Archive CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA, Pixabay Music (free commercial), YouTube Audio Library, Free Music Archive (CC BY/CC0). Each track gets license, credit, and safety=safe|claim_risk. Ingest runs on GitHub Actions (music-ingest.yml).
